description.narrative:
General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2015Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: In 2015, some of the key results with regards to the intended outcome include: 1. TAWLA has advocated extensively for comprehensive rights of women and Children in the second draft of the Constitution that was submmitted to the Constituent Assembly. 2. TAWLA has consistently lobbied for sexual and reproductive Health and rights, good governance and property rights. 3. TAWLA worked with the Gender Land Task Force under the " Mama Ardhi" ( "Mother Land") umbrella, which is also coordinated by TAWLA to ensure that women land rights, are included in the proposed constitution in the effective wording. 4. Different approaches ( such as community conversation,use of paralegals, Community gatherings, seminars to various local Community members and advocacy approach) that have been adapted by TAWLA have made it possible to penetrate upto grassroots of the communities.
The final evaluation report highlights that there has been an increased ownership of Project interventions among the LGA and the Community members and this will enhance sustainability results at various levels.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
